styleRevision.prompt: EDIT IMAGE 1, the existing four-pose skeleton sprite sheet. Image 2 is ONLY the game's hero ART STYLE reference, not a replacement character or layout. Make image 1 SIGNIFICANTLY SIMPLER to blend with image 2: clean playful flat 2D geometric vector-like art, broad rounded shapes, bright clear colors, at most base color plus ONE simple shadow per material. Remove ALL painterly facets, gradient shading, surface texture, scratches, small armor layers, tiny buckles/ornament details and busy cloth folds. Reduce ragged edges to just 2 or 3 large notches per outfit, simplify ribcage to three broad curved bone bars, simplify hands into chunky mitten-like skeletal shapes with 2 finger divisions, feet into simple rounded shapes. Skull is one smooth ivory shape, two simple dark sockets with teal dots, tiny triangle nose, just two tooth divisions. Keep recognizable same fallen hero, same main costume, same equipment, same colored class identity. Keep EXACT 1254 x 1254 canvas, four existing poses, each figure's existing placement, scale, facing, feet baseline, prop positions and hand connections. Preserve all source frame boundaries. Do not reposition or resize characters. Same idle, windup, attack release, hurt poses in same locations. No arrow remaining in bottom-left ranger release. Real transparent background, no shadows, glows, labels or scenery. Do not copy background from image 2. This must look clearly simpler and friendlier, not merely recolored.
